clauses.heading: Payment assistance options
clauses.text: Sydney Water must implement and comply with its payment assistance policy and give it to each residential customer it identifies as experiencing payment difficulty within one business day of identifying them.
clauses.notes: Provision read: cl 23(2), 23(4)(c). Agent identifies payment difficulty but does not trigger provision of the payment assistance policy or apply it.

clauses.heading: External dispute resolution scheme
clauses.text: Sydney Water must be a member of EWON or an alternative external dispute resolution scheme.
clauses.notes: Provision read: cl 27(1). Context for EWON referral obligations. Licence cl 26 also requires an AS 10002:2022 consistent complaints procedure from 1 July 2025.
